paragraphs.text: You daily give new opportunities to your Church to praise you.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Not only the Jews but also the Gentiles in the kingdom of Christ.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He imputes it to his sins and to the sins of the people that God who was accustomed to afflict them withdraws his help from them.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: You will declare yourself to be the preserver of your Church in destroying your enemies, as you did in the Red Sea.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: As of all barbarous nations, and far off.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: He shows that there is no part or creature in the world which is not governed by God's power and providence.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: That is, Shiloh or the rain.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: You have appointed the earth to bring forth food to man's use.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: By this description he shows that all the order of nature is a testimony of God's love toward us, who causes all creatures to serve our need.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: That is, the dumb creatures will not only rejoice for a time for God's benefits, but will continually sing.
paragraphs.label: l
